framing.lineOfInquiry: Raju (P00014) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE031
framing.alternate: Raju (P00014) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: The location records are unreliable
alternateHypotheses.statement: Raju's location records are imprecise or inconsistent (tower-level accuracy, cloned or shared SIM), so they do not reliably place them at the scene.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: The record placing them near the scene (LOCATION) is only accurate to about 1.1 km
The record placing them near the scene (CDR) is only accurate to about 1.5 km

alternateHypotheses.test: Request a tower dump and the handset's GPS logs; check for SIM cloning; rely on high-accuracy fixes only.

alternateHypotheses.title: Someone else used the phone or handset
alternateHypotheses.statement: Some records attributed to Raju were generated by another person using the same phone or handset.
alternateHypotheses.label: Strong

evidence.text: Handset IMEI-357752047116719 is also used by P00013 — another person may have generated some records

alternateHypotheses.test: Handset forensics and SIM CAF/KYC; establish who carried the handset at the incident time (the other user's location, CCTV).

alternateHypotheses.title: The money has a legitimate explanation
alternateHypotheses.statement: The flagged money movements of Raju have an ordinary purpose (salary, rent, property, business) or belong to a co-holder of the account.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

alternateHypotheses.test: Obtain full statements, invoices or agreements and KYC; confirm the stated purpose with the counter-party.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error
alternateHypotheses.statement: Raju was named in the FIR, or assigned a role, without an independent basis.
alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate
alternateHypotheses.test: Re-examine the FIR and statements; record the person's statement and the informant's basis for naming them.

alternateHypotheses.title: The contact was routine, not coordination
alternateHypotheses.statement: Raju's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
alternateHypotheses.label: Weak
